Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a little over a month ago and it arrived with the wrong grill lid. I left a review stating my dissatisfaction and I was promptly contacted by customer service and the situation resolved. The new lid arrived in only a few days and the service team was extremely gracious and helpful.
Results.Title: Great Customer Service

Results.ReviewText: This grill went together easily, and while I would have liked the classic black, I got an excellent deal from in a sort of Lowes blue. While I always loved and regularly use my gas Weber, I wanted to add the option of charcoal. So happy I did. I've cooked with both direct and indirect method (and a combination). I like the coal baskets that Weber offers - allowing me to separate or concentrate the heat. And I've used classic charcoal, lump charcoal (and a combination). I've used soaked wood chips as well as soaked wood chunks, too.  I've made ribs, pork, chicken, burgers, steaks (think as well as thin), chops, whole fish, a whole turkey, sausage (and peppers) and more. Tried the snake method for a longer and slower cooks, using some hardwood for smoke. I love the design of this grill - and its size.  The lid hook is nice to use, but I did also get the add on lid holder - and tend to use that more.  I added the Weber tool hook accessory which fits nicely and lets me keep the cleaning tools handy.  I even spring for the rotisserie feature which not only lets me do the spinning cook, but also offers the increased cooking chamber height by adding the ring. Big turkey fits happily in that space. I like the top and bottom vents - which help with air flow control.  The ash cleanup system is a very nice innovation. I keep this grill out of the garage year-round, but always under a Weber cover. It looks nearly new. I picked up a curved plastic scraper for when I want to do more deep cleaning of the bowl. Surprised I have not seen the Weber version of this tool offered.  The kettle is a nice complement to my Weber fleet of grills (which now includes a pellet smoker). Admittedly, I am a Weber fanboy.
Results.Title: Classic with some innovations.

Photos.Caption: Looks awesome in the yard with the Dodger Blue
Get compliments on it all the time, and my neighbor all of a sudden has a Weber kettle now too!
Cook the best wings of my life on my kettle!
Chicken on a Weber kettle, nothing better!

Results.ReviewText: Great quality as usual from Weber, recommended for anyone without hesitation. Will last forever with minimal care. And makes putting out amazing food easy!
Results.Title: Can’t go wrong with a Weber kettle!

Results.ReviewText: Kettle grill is great as always and what I expect from Webber.  They just need to work on there gas grills now.
Results.Title: 22 inch Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have totally enjoyed using my new Weber experience.
Results.Title: Pure satisfaction since purchasing this grill!

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. We will take your comments into consideration. We would recommend using a grill cover to protect the grill. Thank you for being a long time Weber fan!

Results.ReviewText: I'll start by saying we love Weber grills; but, the cover on the top vent allows rain to enter the grill.
Results.Title: Love weber grills 3rd in 35 yrs last forever

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. This is my third. I use it every time I can.
Results.Title: A classic, never fails!

Results.ReviewText: Having the thermometer in the lid and the redesign of the attachment of the ash receptacle has made this grill even better!  The tripod design is superb on my sloping back yard.
Results.Title: Easy to use and cooks great!

Results.ReviewText: I always wanted a quality long lasting Weber grill.  Classic!
Results.Title: 22” Premium Weber charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Easy to put together, durable and looks clean. Love grilling with the Weber.
Results.Title: Great Purchase

Results.ReviewText: Really great grill. Feels premium and that it will last a long time. I feel confident I'll be able to use this for years to come and have full faith in Weber's customer service team. They already helped me with a damaged handle from shipping. The charcoal cleaner and bucket are easy to use and helpful to have!
Results.Title: Really great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great quality and very versatile. You can cook anything on a Weber kettle
Results.Title: Simply wonderful

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear about the shipping damages, and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. We take all consumer feedback seriously and will relay your disappointing experience to the appropriate team. Please don’t hesitate to reach out to us via email or phone, and our Consumer Care Team will be more than happy to assist. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber in a couple months where it the box their has been issue. With the cost of these they should come flawless and packaging should be better. Unfortunately, this is my last Weber. If you are able to, inspect in store and try to get one already built so you can give it a good look unless dropping $300 isn’t much to you.
Results.Title: Not what they use to be

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Kettle is the most amazing bbq pit to ever grace this planet. The possibilities are endless and the Weber Kettle allows you to cook anything and everything from hot and fast grilling to smoking. Every one should cook on a Weber Kettle at least once in their life as it has changed mine.
Results.Title: Highly recommend

Results.ReviewText: Great charcoal grill.  A little bit of a learning curve regulating temperature and arranging the charcoal, but once you master that, there are endless possibilities of cooking.  I have not cooked with a charcoal grill for over 20 years.  Definitely the way to go.
Results.Title: Charcoal Is King

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill, easy to use and clean.  The ash catcher is an excellent addition.
Results.Title: Great purchase

Results.ReviewText: I had my first Original Kettle from 1992 until this past summer. We made very Thanksgiving turkey on it for all those years with indirect heat and lots of smoke. Everyone loved those turkeys. It was time for a little upgrade. And guess what, I gave the 30 year old grill away. It is still in action!
Results.Title: A little upgrade.

Results.ReviewText: Easy setup and cooking. The size is just right for cooking for 1-4 folks. Slow cooking or direct grilling Steaks, this Weber performs.
Results.Title: Always the best tool for BBQing

Results.ReviewText: Love the color. Love the effectiveness of the grill. That's why I bought the same style and color I had previously and used for many years prior.
Results.Title: My Favorite Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Easy to assemble. Cooke very well. 
Only complaint is there is only ONE handle on the kettle. Another one on the opposite would be very helpful in moving/lifting it .Especially after it has been lit.I believe the older models had TWO. Always skimping quality for profit.
Results.Title: Cooks good,hard to handle

Results.ReviewText:
Can't beat the quality of the tried-and-true Weber Kettle Grill.  I purchased this to replace one I had for 20 plus years, only because it was damaged during moving.  
The ash removal system is improved, much easier to dump them now.  The one thing I liked better on my old Weber it that it had two welded on handles, one on each side, instead of just one.  Not a big deal, but nicer having two if you need to move a hot grill.  All in all, I love it!
Results.Title: BEST GRILL FOR THE MONEY

Results.ReviewText: We finally had to replace our trusty old Weber with this new model and couldn't be happier with it!
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: A great kettle but not what it once was.  Over the 40 plus years I have been using a Weber they have gradually cheaped the product.  The most obvious from my last was now having only one side handle.  You can no longer pick up the entire kettle.  You can only roll it.
Results.Title: Good but not as good as it once was

Results.ReviewText: Well made.  No defects. Works as i expected for a Weber.  Replaced a 25 ur Weber gas
Results.Title: Very mice

Results.ReviewText: Unbeatable, classic, back to basics excellence. Tired of burner maintenance and insufficient heat of my 6-burner propane grill, I went back to basics and got the Weber Original Kettle Premium wherein I use hardwood lump and briquette charcoals. The ability to go direct or indirect and instantly be in charge of my heat is what matters most to me. You can’t beat the effectiveness of the Weber Kettle. I didn’t know how much I missed it. I use mine once or twice a week and I love it. For me, along with my wood and coal burning offset smoker, there is no better way to cook.
Results.Title: Back to Foundational Basics

Results.ReviewText: Love our new grill! Easy to clean, easy to add coal, and the temperature gauge makes it easy to monitor without having to lift the cover! This was a replacement for our last weber grill... one my dad had been using since the 80s that we took over using about 10 years ago! Weber has always been tried and true.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Purchased in 2015 and still looks like new. Making meatballs today.
Results.Title: Weber Forever

Results.ReviewText: I have a second home near a lake in Wisconsin and the home came with an older Weber grill that since then was rusting out, charcoal grate tabs were gone and the cooking grate had troubles supporting food. I cannot express enough how my new Weber performs. The food cooks more evenly and tastes better. The charcoal burns more evenly. I would never settle for just any grill. I recommend Weber to everyone.
Results.Title: Nothing compares to a Weber

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are really sorry to hear of your experience. The height of the charcoal grate cannot be adjusted. We will be sure to share your comments with our team for consideration. If there is anything else we can do to help please reach out direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Not my favorite grill. Cant adjust heightbof coals
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill but my old one had two handles on it front and back this one does not. The second handle is nice to have if you are loading in back of truck to take some where else to cook or to just pick it up over something in the way.
Results.Title: needs second handle

Results.ReviewText: After more than 40 years of using gas grills, stick-burners, and pellet smokers, I realized that I wanted to go back to a simpler (time-tested) method of cooking. All of those types of grills have their place but there’s just something about taking your time and creating the perfect-tasting piece of meat. I needed the kettle and it will be part of my bbq arsenal for many years.
Results.Title: Slow down and enjoy the process

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
